agent_notes: The NIRF 2025 Engineering and Overall listings contain the exact institution name with Lucknow, Uttar Pradesh.

Normal TLS verification returned the exact proxy certificate error 'self signed certificate in certificate chain'; public GETs were retried with --insecure only for the expected NIRF, Bing, and bansaliet.in hosts.

The official homepage lists 12 course names, while the current 2026 prospectus uses some different names and omits Agricultural Engineering; the 2026 Spot Admission notice names only Electrical Engineering, Bio Technology, and Information Technology. This official-source catalogue inconsistency requires manual review.

The homepage lists B.Tech. Computer Science (AI), B.Tech. Computer Science (AI & ML), M.Tech. Computer Science, and MBA without dedicated programme-page links; these are supported by the official 2026 prospectus, but the catalogue is not uniformly maintained.

The supplied institution_type is government_college, while the official website describes the institute as managed by Bansal Educational Trust; the exact campus and NIRF identity match, but the classification discrepancy is noted for review.

Career mappings were read from assets/data/career_path.db in read-only mode. Agricultural Engineering has no exact career-tree node and is mapped to the nearest B.Tech / B.E. parent; M.Tech Computer Science is mapped to the closest Computer Science specialization node.
